task.summary: feat(Mobile): add Mobile README, update root README & PROJECT_OVERVIEW tech stack 4/10
feat(Mobile): build mock-data UI for Member, Coach and Manager flows 8/10

feat: connect mobile to real API and implement shop flow 10/10
- BE: mobile API gaps, auth security fixes (OTP reset, login order), shop module (cart, addresses, checkout, order state machine, inventory ledger, pickup code, manager tools, anti-abuse limits), SePay/refund integration, migrations 20261010000000_mobile_api_gaps and 20261011000000_shop_flow, local e2e/smoke tests - Mobile: network layer + realtime, real API by default, shop screens (cart, checkout, orders, addresses) and manager screens (orders, pickup scan, inventory), mocks and tests - Docs: shop flow design, BE API changes, mobile integration notes

feat(shop): pickup date & pay-at-counter, no-show handling, in-order refunds on web; collapsible manager sidebar 20/10
- Ship fee 30.000 -> 15.000. PICKUP: choose pickup date (today..+7), pick up early once ready, hold until end of (pickup date + 3), reschedule once (max +3 days), reminder 24h before deadline - Pay at counter (CASH, PICKUP only): new status CONFIRMED (stock reserved, no Payment); manager confirms code + phone + cash collected => CASH payment + COMPLETED; limits 2.000.000đ / 1 open order - Overdue pickup (no-show, counted over 90 days): unpaid => cancel + release stock, no refund; paid => return stock + 100% refund (10% holding fee from 3rd no-show); 2nd no-show => pay-at-counter locked 30 days; pending refund > 30 days flagged as stale - Refunds: payoutMethod BANK_TRANSFER | CASH, bank transfer requires customer bank info, customer updates bank info in app, manager can remind (1/hour), cancel & refund requires a reason - Web manager: order dialog shows payment + refund blocks with approve/reject/remind in place, cash collection on pickup, queues (pickup today / refund pending / stale refund), no-show badge - Web manager sidebar: toggle button on the divider, collapsible parent groups, groups also collapse when sidebar is collapsed - Mobile: pickup date chips + payment method on checkout, reschedule + bank form on order detail, mock + tests - Migration 20261020000000_shop_pickup_cash, e2e shop tests, OpenAPI/FE client regenerated, Doc/SHOP_FLOW_DESIGN.md §10

feat: harden course sales, payments, invoices and revenue reporting (late-join pricing, sale cutoff, seat holds, class maintenance job, snapshot-based invoices with full cost breakdown) and complete the membership flow (plan CRUD, rotating QR pass with entry log, queued plans, renewal reminders, manager cancellation with refunds) across BE, Mobile and Web 25/10
